wombos.definition: Someone obsessively into looksmaxxing — vain, try-hard, and deeply invested in their physical appearance above all else. The poster child of gym-bro aesthetics taken too far.

Kirk-level charisma — the magnetic aura of someone who has fully committed to the Kirk identity and radiates it as natural, unshakeable magnetism. 'He has kirkrisma. His aura has gotten so large I can't even feel it anymore.'
